Post 1

Defense names lit up while gold stocks bled out. ASX 200 closed +0.41% to 8,732.40 pts. Financials carried the index; materials dragged. The market is flat year-to-date but down 0.99% over five days. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🏦 Financials led all sectors at +1.42%. Health Care added +0.98%. Energy fell -1.10% and IT dropped -0.98%. The rotation away from growth and resources into defensives and banks tells the real story today. #ASX #banking #energy

Post 3

🔺 EOS surged +7.99% to AUD 10.00. Electro Optic Systems and stablemate DroneShield (+6.77%) both ripped — defense tech is catching a bid as geopolitical risk premiums stay elevated. Two names, one clear theme. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold in AUD hit 6,131.36/oz yet gold miners Pantoro and West African Resources fell 7.45% and 7.37% respectively. Record local gold price, stocks selling off — that disconnect is worth watching closely. #gold #ASX #mining

Post 5

Gold miners cracking while spot AUD gold holds 6,131.36/oz is the week's sharpest contradiction. Does it resolve higher for stocks or lower for the metal? What's your read — miners catching up or gold rolling over? #gold #ASX #ausbiz
